reason: Claims Unaliased/OriginalScheme are the only distinguishing fields; omits url.Scheme, which also retains cockroachdb/cockroach versus postgres.
Rejection rule considers only start/stop and leaves out the valid legacy page alternative, so page-only requests would be wrongly rejected.
Postgres migration driver is not viable on CockroachDB: its Lock uses pg_advisory_lock, unsupported there; wire compatibility does not make it work.
page does not remain undefined; it becomes 1 and start is explicitly computed; stop is perPage-1, only 19 with default perPage.
With perPage undefined, start = Math.max(0, page-1) * undefined = NaN, not 0; both start and stop are NaN.
States wrong version value for the right object: QtWebEngine in this environment is 5.15.2 per the test header and issue.
uid may be numeric from socket or direct callers, but REST passes it as a string Express path parameter; stated universally.
Truthiness check catches only all-missing pagination; leaves out malformed truthy values like start:'bad', which bypass invalid-data.
Microcopy reads privateShouldBeEncrypted, canChangeEncryption and isVideoRoom; isEncrypted only drives the toggle value, so the dependency is misstated.
Treats all negative durations as clearly invalid, but go-redis accepts negative sentinels (-1, -2) for ConnMaxIdleTime and read/write timeouts.
hasPrivateChat only rejects uid <= 0; there is no integer check, so 1.5 passes. Validation is overstated.
Names models.DiffPlus and a DiffStatus field that do not exist at BASE; recalled upstream code. Current-only branch just stores v.
Cites a version_check('5.12', compiled=False) call in webenginetab.py; the actual call is version_check('5.12') with default compiled=True.
Leaves out required work: the issue explicitly asks for a documented Docker Compose example for running Flipt with CockroachDB.
On the URL route mid is a required path parameter, so it cannot be undefined; socket path gets roomId from the message.
Approximate 2021 timeframe is fine, but trivy v0.15.0 is dated 2020-12-21, not January 2021.
getMessageField(0,'roomId') returns 0, not undefined: missing field is null and parseIntFields normalizes it via parseInt(...) || 0.
compare only recurses for type 'object'; the allOf response property has no type, so the roomId assertion is never reached.
file_flipt_proto_rawDesc is a []byte literal in this generated code, not a string literal; descriptor role is correct.
Proto/Swagger edits are necessary but not sufficient; leaves out regenerating pb.go and evaluator code assigning reason on each outcome path.
Verifier reads it as top-level null; getObjects always returns an array, with null elements. In context agent meant [null], plausibly correct.
Index computation is right (2) but the value at index 2 of [1,2,3] is 3, not 2; index confused with value.
Using postgres.WithInstance for CockroachDB selects the advisory-lock Postgres driver instead of the required CockroachDB driver with lock table.
Attributes the 1/20 defaults to api/chats.js list; they actually live in controllers/write/chats.js, which computes start/stop before calling the API.
Version 1.14.0 is right, but the changelog dates its release 2020-10-15, not around January 2022.
getRecentChats returns an object {rooms, nextStart} via the filter hook, not a bare array of room data.
Predicate default is right, but omits the content.site_specific_quirks.enabled early return, which blocks injection even when not skipped.
Greedy (.*) captures up to the last viable '('; equals text before the first parenthesis only when the signature has one '('.
Overlooks init_log(), called before check_qt_version(), which imports qutebrowser.utils.log; earlyinit is not the only import.
Only content comes through api.chats.getRawMessage; roomId is fetched beforehand from Messaging.getMessageField, not through the API.
Issue requires a documented Compose example but no examples/cockroachdb path. Quote's 'explicitly requires' likely meant docs, which is true.
Mechanism leaves out the pre-resolution submit window. Refutation weak: the original fallback has the same window, since canChangeEncryption starts true.
dburl's cockroachdb scheme sets Override postgres, so URL.Driver (what Flipt reads) becomes postgres; cockroachdb is only the Unaliased name.
!mid || !roomId catches only missing values; leaves out malformed truthy ids like mid 'abc', which reach getRawMessage without invalid-data.
First parameter of NewWithDatabaseInstance is a source URL (parsed as URL), not a source name; the other two parameters are right.
BASE version_check uses pkg_resources.parse_version throughout; no QVersionNumber or normalized() call. Recalled a later implementation.
Scope rule excludes the issue's OCI source.go. Refutation weak: that section is an unrelated distractor whose deps would break the navidrome build.
Quoted panic occurs only with no test object and no closest call; otherwise FailNow or the 'Unexpected Method Call' message.
Issue requires the CockroachDB migration driver; Postgres driver uses pg_advisory_lock, while Cockroach driver uses a lock table and ExecuteTx.
Only AlbumGridView must pass true; other callers like AlbumDetails can omit square and get the default false behavior.
